_comment: Crown lands (Monarchy) and Dark Pacts (Covenant). The capital land is assigned to the starting city; every other city can take one land of its faction (each only once). A land unlocks its units and adds its bonus (research-style modifiers).

croatia.name: Kingdom of Croatia-Slavonia
croatia.description: The Military Frontier. Unlocks the Grenzer; invaders suffer more attrition in your land.

bohemia.name: Kingdom of Bohemia
bohemia.description: Hussite wagon forts and Kutná Hora silver. Unlocks the War Wagon; +0.5/s Thaler cap.

tyrol.name: County of Tyrol
tyrol.description: Alpine marksmen and forests. Unlocks the Standschütze; +0.5/s Timber cap.

hungary.name: Kingdom of Hungary
hungary.description: The Pannonian plains: grain and horses. Unlocks the Hussar; +0.5/s Provisions cap.

bone.name: Bone Pact
bone.description: Unlocks the Bone Golem; +10% military HP.

shadow.name: Shadow Pact
shadow.description: Unlocks the Wraith; invaders suffer more attrition in your land.
